## play.start

Runs a copy of the scene with scripts, physics and audio. Changes made while playing are discarded by play.stop. When the project's scripts need building first (their sources changed since the module was built, or scenes use scripts that are not built or loaded), it builds them, then plays the new code: the answer comes once the build finished (a failed build fails play.start with its first errors; script.status lists every diagnostic). A build already running is waited for. While a scene is being opened (scene.open) it fails at once, building nothing. paused: true starts the game paused before its first fixed step (fixedSteps 0, also after a build), so play.step, input.sequence and viewport.capture {live, atFixedStep} see it from its first step. Returns the play state and, when it built, built: {build, seconds, reason}.

Kind: `Session` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `core`, `play` · Answers later (MayDefer): yes · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/Commands/PlayCommands.cpp:131`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `build` | boolean | no |   | Build the scripts first when they need it (default true); false plays what is loaded. |
| `paused` | boolean | no |   | Start paused before the first fixed step (default false). |

## play.state

Whether the scene is being edited, played or simulated, whether it is paused, the steps play.step still runs (pendingSteps), the fixed steps run since play started (fixedSteps), and what runs (running, null in edit mode): {scene (the scene asset the game switched to, null while the edited scene's copy runs), name, path, entityCount, subScenes: \[{id, scene, name, state, entities}\] (a world's cells are left out: world sums them up), world: {world, cellsWanted, cellsLoading, cellsLoaded, cellsUnloading, cellsFailed} while a world streams, else null, physics: {bodies (body slots in use), awake, stepMs (the last physics step)} or null without a physics world (physics.stats has more), interpolation: {enabled: drawn between fixed steps (the project's Scene.Timing Interpolation in games, Play and Simulate outside scripted runs), stepAlpha: how far between the last two steps' poses this frame draws, entities: how many are drawn between them}, switching: {scene, progress} while a scene the game asked for loads, else null}.

## play.step

While paused, runs fixed steps of the game, one per frame (frames run unthrottled meanwhile, so 600 steps take the frames' work, not ten seconds), and answers once its last step ran: {state, paused, stepsRun, frameIndex, time, fixedSteps (run since play started)}. Results are exact: the same steps give the same state whatever the frame rate. A play.step while another waits adds its steps after them and answers when its own last step ran. If the game is resumed (play.pause {paused: false} drops steps not run yet), stopped, crashes or quits first, it fails with stepsRun so far. wait: false answers at once with pendingSteps (the steps run over the next frames).

Kind: `Session` · Results: `Content` · MCP toolsets: `core`, `play` · Answers later (MayDefer): yes · Waits for the asset scan: no · Registered at `StrataEditor/src/Editor/Commands/PlayCommands.cpp:191`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `frames` | integer | no |   | Same as steps (an older name: each step runs in a frame of its own). Value: at least `1`, at most `100000`. |
| `steps` | integer | no |   | Fixed steps to run (default 1). Value: at least `1`, at most `100000`. |
| `wait` | boolean | no |   | Answer once the steps ran (default true); false answers at once. |
